arguments.text:
Implemented all 3 milestones in order on top of base:
- m1: Modified naturalday() in src/humanize/time.py to compute "today" in the datetime's own timezone using datetime.now(value.tzinfo).date() for tz-aware inputs; naive datetimes and plain dates unchanged.
- m2: Modified naturaldate() in src/humanize/time.py with the same tz-aware today computation, so its year-append threshold check uses the correct tz-aware reference date.
- m3: Modified naturalsize() in src/humanize/filesize.py to check if the formatted mantissa reached the base after rounding, and step up one suffix if available (values at largest suffix QB/QiB unaffected).

All 684 tests pass across all test files. Three commits made: m1→m2→m3, each changing only library source.
